version-lockstep and release-specific guards, linting, type-checking, full test suite, build, and twine checks must all pass before gerrit submission and CI verification

MCP Registry, Homebrew tap, and channel installation of nava-rebar[mcp]==0.11.0 must all reflect the new version with probe_rebar.py passing zero-failure acceptance
docs/releasing.md prescribes incorrect provenance verifier tooling (GitHub SLSA attestation instead of PyPI PEP 740 bundle verification); follow-up bug must correct runbook and workflow comments
